question: For $$A=\begin{bmatrix}-2 & 3 \\ 1 & -4 \\ 5 & 0\end{bmatrix},$$ find $-3A$. Hence find the sum of all entries of $-3A$.
explanation:
Scalar multiplication
Multiplying every entry of $A$ by $-3$, $$-3A=\begin{bmatrix}6 & -9 \\ -3 & 12 \\ -15 & 0\end{bmatrix}$$
Sum of entries
$$6-9-3+12-15+0=-9$$
Hence, the sum of all entries of $-3A$ is $-9$.
